description: spikeenc.features.featurise checked against a literal transcription of proposal equation (32), plus order invariance and polarity folding. The shipped version accumulates recursively for O(N+F); this records what that optimisation costs in accuracy.
encoder_specs_comment: The mid-range operating points from the tests/conftest.py registry. E2 is omitted because it shares E3's rule under D30; E5 and E6 are stubs.
relative_error_floor_comment: Frames with no accumulated events are exactly zero in both routes; the floor keeps 0/0 out of the relative error.
